about_the_game:
TechRunners is a Cyberpunk-inspired MMORPG that blends multiple gameplay genres into a top-down 2D experience. Step into the city of New Haven, a thriving metropolis ruled by megacorporations and TechRunners like yourself. Navigate the city's dynamic world, where crews battle for territory. Create one with friends or join an existing faction. Head to Star Arena, where intense virtual combat lets you fight other TechRunners and rack up creds for victories. Explore the expansive map, interact with unique groups and landmarks, take on professions, build a house, hatch pets, complete quests, and more. TechRunners features 360° shooting and free movement, giving you the freedom to craft any loadout you desire from an armory packed with over 100 weapons. With fast-paced PvP combat that constantly tests reflexes and skill, every battle is an opportunity to prove your dominance.

Hop into an addicting 25 vs 25 PvP experience!

Basing in TechRunners' is all about claiming bases and keeping them. Bases are scattered around the map and open 24/7. Create a crew of up to 50 friends, or join any of the crews constantly battling for control. Use the crew chat to strategize attacks, defend your turf, and call out plays in real time. The longer you hold a base, the more creds you rack up, unlocking custom rewards along the way. Lock down a home base, or take over the whole map ensuring constant chaos.

1vs1, 2vs2, 5vs5, and even 10vs10!

Dueling is the premier sporting event in the TechRunners' world. Citizens of New Haven gather at Star Arena to watch intense battles unfold across various dueling venues. As a TechRunner, engage in virtual combat against other TechRunners. Go solo or team up with a friend as a duo. Have a bigger squad? Larger fighting venues, such as 5v5 and 10v10, are available for full-scale battles. Grab any loadout and rack up creds by dueling at Star Arena. Become a Virtual Reality Gladiator and prove your dominance.

Meet new people and long lasting friends!

TechRunners brings New Haven to life with a massive open world full of opportunities to connect. Meet new players across the map and forge friendships as you explore. Fight together in Star Arena, or team up with a Crew to take over bases and dominate the city. Engage in global chat to connect with the entire player base, or talk privately in Crew chat with your squad. Trade valuable items in the open market or the Trading Hub, ensuring you always get the best deals. With over 100,000 customization options, your character is fully yours. If presets aren’t your style, you can upload custom graphics to make your look truly unique. Join our Discord to be part of the thriving TechRunners community, where our dedicated staff is always available to assist new and veteran players alike.

  • Processor: If it can run youtube, all is well

  • Graphics: If it can run youtube, you're in good hands
  • Sound Card: If it can play sounds, golden!

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: TechRunners is an open-world 2D MMORPG set in the city of New Haven, where survival means climbing to the top. Start from nothing, build your empire, and take on rival TechRunners and Megacorporations. Form a crew to take control of the city or use your talents to climb the arena rankings.
